Hot-pink pompom domes cover a whole tilted plate of bare rock so completely the colour reads almost unreal, every dome cut flat and level right across the top.
Pink pompom domes crowd a bank of scoured wiry grass, the seaward half of each dome dried to dead brown and gone brittle, the sheltered half still green, the line between the two sharp and straight.
Loose sprays of white flowers with deeply notched petals trail between pink pompom domes over a shoulder of peaty ground, every stem leaning inland at the same angle.
Clusters of small egg-yolk-yellow pea-shaped flowers in woolly grey-green heads grow banked thick in the lee of a boulder, thinning to nothing where the ground opens and the wind finds them.
Egg-yolk-yellow pea flowers in woolly grey-green heads press against bright orange crusty lichen spreading over a slab in rings, the two colours running side by side across the rock.
Low sprawling patches of small yellow-and-orange pea flowers cover a hollow floored with thin dark soil, the seaward edges dried to dead brown and gone brittle while the sheltered centres stay green.

Stiff low patches of purple-flowered heather and gorse solid with egg-yolk-yellow flowers are cut flat and level right across the top at exactly the same height, the two colours reading as one level surface.

Gorse bushes solid with egg-yolk-yellow flowers over dark spines are cut flat and level across the top, the seaward face of each bush dried to dead brown and gone brittle, the inland face still green.

Thick fleshy bright-green segmented stems wedge into a crack in a slab, the flat heads of tiny yellow flowers on the seaward side dried to dead brown and gone brittle, the sheltered side still flowering.
Thick fleshy bright-green segmented stems crowd a wet crack alongside small white four-petalled flowers over thick round dark-green leaves, both plants jammed tight into the stone.

Small white four-petalled flowers over thick round dark-green leaves grow flat on a tilted plate of rock, the seaward leaves dried to dead brown and gone brittle, the sheltered leaves still dark and full.
Flat purple-pink patches of tiny wild thyme flowers spread over warm bare rock between bands of grey-green crusty lichen and black crusty lichen, every patch leaning slightly inland.

Flat purple-pink thyme patches and low sprawling yellow-and-orange pea flowers share a shallow step down in the stone, the thyme's seaward edge dried to dead brown and gone brittle, the rest still flowering.

Tiny white star-shaped flowers over swollen red-tinged leaves lie dead flat on a table of bare rock, the seaward leaves dried to dead brown and gone brittle, the sheltered leaves still swollen and red.

Small violet daisy flowers with gold centres grow on fleshy stems jammed into a crack, every flower head leaning inland, the seaward stems dried to dead brown and gone brittle while the sheltered stems stay green.

White daisy flowers with gold centres over feathery leaves lean so far inland their stems are bent permanently, the seaward half of each plant dried to dead brown and gone brittle, the sheltered half still white and flowering.
Big white daisies with gold centres lean inland in a stiff row along a broken rim of turf, the seaward faces dried to dead brown and gone brittle, the sheltered faces still open and white.
Dense heads of hot coral-pink flowers on tall arching stems stand in the shelter of one large boulder, the open ground on every side holding nothing taller than ankle-high purple-flowered heather.

Bluebells in one tight patch grow in the lee of a boulder, bright and upright on the sheltered side, the boulder's seaward face coated in grey-green crusty lichen and black crusty lichen in hard bands.
Pale yellow primrose flowers sit low in grass cropped to almost nothing, each low tuft of leaves with its seaward half dried to dead brown and gone brittle, the sheltered half still pale and soft.

White flowers with notched petals over pale green swollen pods trail across a tumble of loose broken stone, the seaward pods dried to dead brown and gone brittle, the sheltered pods still swollen and pale.

Flat white lacy flower plates on hairy stems grow banked thick behind a shoulder of peaty ground, the seaward half of every stem dried to dead brown and gone brittle, the sheltered half still carrying white plates.

Small violet daisy flowers with gold centres and small white four-petalled flowers over thick round dark-green leaves fill a hollow floored with thin dark soil, both species leaning inland at the same hard angle.

Bright orange crusty lichen spreads over a slab in rings beside grey-green and black crusty lichen in bands, the whole surface running right across the picture from one edge to the other, and then open water far below.

Clusters of small egg-yolk-yellow pea-shaped flowers in woolly grey-green heads grow alongside flat purple-pink thyme patches on a bank of scoured wiry grass, the seaward half of each woolly head dried to dead brown and gone brittle.
